fhparry.audio.desc: Play random custom Parry_0x.wav clips on successful parries.
fhparry.audio.name: Play Audio Feedback
fhparry.camera.character.desc: Off holds the camera still during your own actions. On is more cinematic, but a party camera can still be settling when a fast enemy attack begins, and an attack you cannot see is one you cannot parry.
fhparry.camera.character.name: Allow Camera Moves on Party Attacks
fhparry.camera.flow.desc: Diagnostic. The battle state machine's framing cameras at battle start, encounter load and battle end. Leave on; turning it off answers whether a camera that will not settle came from the game's flow rather than from a turn script.
fhparry.camera.flow.name: Allow the Game's Own Battle Framing
fhparry.camera.monster.desc: Off holds the camera still while an enemy attacks, so the wind-up stays in frame. On restores the game's own camera script for enemy actions.
fhparry.camera.monster.name: Allow Camera Moves on Enemy Attacks
fhparry.camera_probe.desc: Diagnostic, Debug builds only. Logs each battle-camera call and the state that decided it, whether or not it was suppressed.
fhparry.camera_probe.name: Log Every Camera Call
fhparry.debug_overlay.desc: The mod's own window with the live, lab, command and camera tabs. Debug builds only.
fhparry.debug_overlay.name: Show the Diagnostic Window
desc: Timing-based inputs during enemy attacks. Toggle parry and choose a difficulty preset.
fhparry.difficulty.desc: 0 = Easy, 1 = Normal, 2 = Expert. Debug builds additionally offer 3 = Debug. Each preset sets the parry and dodge windows and recovery after an input that hits nothing.
fhparry.difficulty.name: Difficulty: 0 Easy / 1 Normal / 2 Expert
fhparry.dodge.desc: A separate, wider timing window that steps the character out of the attack. Safer than a parry, but it grants neither the counter nor the overdrive charge.
fhparry.dodge.name: Enable Dodge
fhparry.enabled.desc: Master switch for the parry helper.
fhparry.enabled.name: Enable Parry
fhparry.future.name: Future Features
fhparry.impact_shake.desc: Shake the screen when a successful parry meets the hit. A whole-party parry (all three PCs) shakes harder.
fhparry.impact_shake.name: Impact Screen Shake
fhparry.logging.desc: Records parry and dodge decisions, camera permissions and hook activity to the mod's log.
fhparry.logging.name: Write a Session Log
name: Parry Prototype
fhparry.native_probe_logging.desc: Experimental, Debug builds only. Requires a restart to install the native probes. Some native signatures remain unverified. Logging is independent of the session log setting.
fhparry.native_probe_logging.name: Log Native Engine Probes
fhparry.parry_effect.desc: Fire a NulShock-style shield flash on the parrying character on a successful parry. Pure visual feedback, no gameplay state effect.
fhparry.parry_effect.name: Parry Visual Effect
fhparry.parry_native_block.desc: Experimental, Debug builds only. Drives the engine's own guard reaction on a successful parry instead of the mod's feedback.
fhparry.parry_native_block.name: Use the Native Block Reaction
fhparry.streak_counter.desc: When a slot completes a defensive streak (every targeted slot in a cue parried at least once and the cumulative streak reaches the threshold), automatically queue a basic Attack from the parrier onto the original attacker. Uses the engine's own auto-counter cue insertion path so CTB scheduling stays consistent.
fhparry.streak_counter.name: Streak Counter Attack
